description: PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/password takes the new password as hashes instead of plaintext. The converter marks newPasswordHash (SHA-256) sensitive by name, but its sibling newDoubleSha1Hash (the MySQL-protocol double SHA-1 of the same password) has no mark, so the same secret leaked through the other field. Source: the OpenAPI document served at https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1 (2026-11-11).
